title: It’s Cozy Season. Ruggable’s October Sale Is Right on Time
gist: Affiliate-style Wired promotion for Ruggable's October Hosting Sale (up to 30 percent off select styles, ending October 25), listing sale prices on four rugs. The author praises washability but notes slipping nonslip pads, curling edges and reports of fading prints.

insights.claim: Ruggable's October Hosting Sale offers up to 30 percent off select styles and ends October 25, excluding the new Easy Care Wool collection, gift cards, spot cleaner and rug pads.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Time-limited promo; promotional discount depth ranges 20-25 percent on featured 6x9 rugs.
insights.locator: Ruggable’s October Hosting Sale is one of my favorite

insights.claim: Featured 6x9 Ruggable rugs are discounted 20-25 percent, e.g. Santiago Persian Tufted from $499 to $374 and Mandalore Scarlet Red from $549 to $439.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Gives concrete price points for seasonal home-goods discounting.

insights.claim: The author argues the core appeal of Ruggable is that a machine-washable rug can be lived on, with spills, pet accidents and stains handled in the washer and dryer.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Washability is the product differentiator in a crowded home-decor category.

insights.claim: Ruggable offers 2,122 designs and regularly provides alternatives to discontinued styles.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Wide catalog supports SKU breadth as a retention lever.
insights.quote: Ruggable has thousands of designs to choose from—2,122 to date.

insights.claim: Reviewers report Ruggable shortcomings: the nonslip pad shifts and is a tripping hazard, aligning a rug onto the pad can take two people, edges can curl, and customers report print fading.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Quality complaints are the main risk to repeat purchase; the author dismisses fading as expected for machine-washable rugs.

insights.claim: Revival, which sells hand-knotted and woven imported wool rugs, is running its own 20-percent-off sitewide sale as a competing option.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Shows rival promotions clustering in the same seasonal window.
